definitions.text_mt: L-istadju meta fjura tiftaħ u turi l-petali tagħha

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġnien kollu kien fil-fjuritura fir-rebbiegħa.
usage_examples.en: The whole garden was in bloom in spring.

usage_examples.mt: Din is-sena l-fjuritura waslet kmieni minħabba s-sħana.
usage_examples.en: This year the blossoming came early because of the heat.

definitions.text_mt: Kwalunkwe sustanza li tinħaraq biex tipproduċi l-enerġija, bħalma huma l-petrol, id-diżil jew il-gass

usage_examples.mt: Il-karozza tiegħi għandha bżonn il-fjuwil.
usage_examples.en: My car needs fuel.

usage_examples.mt: Il-prezz tal-fjuwil għola b'mod konsiderevoli din il-ġimgħa.
usage_examples.en: The price of fuel rose considerably this week.

usage_examples.mt: Iż-żejt mhux l-uniku tip ta' fjuwil; hemm ukoll il-gass u l-elettriku.
usage_examples.en: Oil is not the only type of fuel; there is also gas and electricity.

definitions.text_en: used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see f', il-, skiet

Fis-skiet, mingħajr ebda ħoss

B'mod kwiet, mingħajr storbju

definitions.text_en: without speaking (during something or about something)
definitions.text_mt: Mingħajr ma wieħed jitkellem, la waqt attività u lanqas dwar suġġett

usage_examples.mt: Qagħdu fl-iskiet matul iċ-ċerimonja kollha.
usage_examples.en: They remained in silence throughout the whole ceremony.

usage_examples.mt: Il-klassi studjat fl-iskiet għal aktar minn siegħa.
usage_examples.en: The class studied in silence for more than an hour.

usage_examples.mt: Fl-iskiet irnexxielhom jisimgħu t-taħdita.
usage_examples.en: Silently they managed to hear the lecture.

definitions.text_mt: Għasfur kbir b'rix roża u għonq twil li jgħix f'artijiet bassasa (Phoenicopterus roseus)

usage_examples.mt: Rajna l-flamingo fil-Menqa ta' San Pawl il-Baħar.
usage_examples.en: We saw the flamingo at Salina Bay in St Paul's Bay.

usage_examples.mt: Il-flamingo huwa wieħed mill-aktar għasafar sbieħ li wieħed jista' jara.
usage_examples.en: The flamingo is one of the most beautiful birds one can see.

definitions.text_mt: Drapp artab u ħafif, ġeneralment minsi bil-ħajt, użat għall-ilbies tax-xitwa

usage_examples.mt: Il-flanella tintuża ħafna għall-piġami tax-xitwa.
usage_examples.en: Flannel is often used for winter pyjamas.

usage_examples.mt: Il-qmis tal-flanella li xtrajt huwa komdu ħafna.
usage_examples.en: The flannel shirt I bought is very comfortable.

definitions.text_mt: Sar ipokrita, tilef is-sinċerità fl-imġiba tiegħu

usage_examples.en: After that experience, he became suspicious and no longer trusted anyone.

usage_examples.mt: Meta rahom jitkellmu warajh, flaz kompletament.
usage_examples.en: When he saw them talking behind his back, he became completely hypocritical.

definitions.text_mt: Fellus ta' daqs żgħir, flusu

usage_examples.mt: Il-flejles kien qiegħed jiġri wara ommu madwar il-bitħa.

definitions.text_mt: Testikolu ta' daqs żgħir

usage_examples.mt: It-tabib eżamina l-flejli tal-pazjent waqt iż-żjara.
usage_examples.en: The doctor examined the patient's small testicle during the visit.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-għaxija, matul il-ħin ta' wara nofsinhar sal-lejl

usage_examples.mt: Nixtiequ niltaqgħu flgħaxija wara x-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: We would like to meet in the evening after work.

usage_examples.mt: Jien inħobb immur nimxi flgħaxija meta jkun frisk.
usage_examples.en: I like to go for a walk in the evening when it is cool.

definitions.text_mt: Il-ħin ta' wara nofsinhar sal-lejl

usage_examples.mt: Il-flgħaxija kienet sabiħa u trankwilla.
usage_examples.en: The evening was beautiful and tranquil.

usage_examples.mt: Kull flgħaxija niltaqgħu fil-kafè tal-viċinat.
usage_examples.en: Every evening we meet at the neighbourhood cafe.

definitions.text_mt: Wieħed flien, persuna mhux imsemmija b'isimha

definitions.text_en: a placeholder for a person whose name one cannot or does not want to mention, as in the phrase 'wieħed flien'
definitions.text_mt: Kliem li jintuża minflok isem ta' persuna li ma tistax jew ma tridx issemmi, bħal fl-espressjoni 'wieħed flien'

usage_examples.mt: Ilbieraħ iltqajt ma' wieħed flien li ma niftakarx ismu.
usage_examples.en: Yesterday I met so-and-so whose name I cannot recall.

usage_examples.mt: Flien u martu ġew iżżurna l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
usage_examples.en: So-and-so and his wife came to visit us last week.

definitions.text_mt: Xi ħadd, min, persuna mhux speċifikata

usage_examples.mt: Hemm flien jistenniek barra fil-karozza.
usage_examples.en: There is somebody waiting for you outside in the car.

usage_examples.mt: Jekk flien jgħidlek hekk, emminha għax normalment ikun jaf x'jgħid.
usage_examples.en: If anybody tells you that, believe it because he usually knows what he is talking about.

definitions.text_mt: Ma' xulxin, f'kumpanija waħda, b'mod konġunt

usage_examples.mt: Il-familja kollha qagħdet flimkien għall-pranzu tal-Ħadd.
usage_examples.en: The whole family sat together for Sunday dinner.

usage_examples.mt: Jekk naħdmu flimkien, nistgħu nlestu l-proġett aktar malajr.
usage_examples.en: If we work together, we can finish the project more quickly.

usage_examples.mt: Huma jmorru l-iskola flimkien kuljum bil-mixi.
usage_examples.en: They go to school together every day on foot.

definitions.text_mt: Kontenitur tal-ħġieġ jew tal-plastik b'għonq dejjaq użat biex iżomm likwidi

usage_examples.mt: Ixtri flixkun ilma mill-ħanut tal-kantina.
usage_examples.en: Buy a bottle of water from the corner shop.

usage_examples.mt: Il-flixkun tal-inbid kien fuq il-mejda l-ġdida.
usage_examples.en: The wine bottle was on the new table.

usage_examples.mt: Ġib miegħek flixkun tal-ilma meta tmur għall-mixja.
usage_examples.en: Bring a bottle of water with you when you go for a walk.

definitions.text_mt: L-azzjoni tal-qsim, tad-diviżjoni jew tal-firda ta' xi ħaġa

usage_examples.mt: Il-fliġ tal-injam ħa ħafna ħin bil-mannara l-qadima.
usage_examples.en: The splitting of the wood took a long time with the old axe.

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-fliġ tal-ftehim, kull naħa marret għal tagħha.
usage_examples.en: After the split of the agreement, each side went its own way.

definitions.text_mt: Minflok, bħala sostitut ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa

usage_examples.mt: Mur int floku jekk ma jistax imur hu stess.
usage_examples.en: Go instead of him if he cannot go himself.

usage_examples.mt: Flok tiekol il-ħelu, aħjar tiekol il-frott.
usage_examples.en: Instead of eating sweets, it is better to eat fruit.

usage_examples.mt: Flok ma toqgħod tara t-televiżjoni, aqra ktieb.
usage_examples.en: Instead of sitting watching television, read a book.

definitions.text_mt: Ilbies ta' fuq tal-ġisem, ġeneralment bil-kmiem u b'fetħa ta' quddiem
Għoqda li tinħall faċilment billi tiġbed tarf wieħed tal-ħabel
Qlugħ trijangolari mqiegħed quddiem l-arblu prinċipali ta' bastiment

usage_examples.mt: Il-flokk li libes kien abjad u kollu mal-ġisem.
usage_examples.en: The shirt he wore was white and tight-fitting.

usage_examples.mt: Il-baħri għamel flokk mal-ħabel biex iżomm id-dgħajsa marbuta.
usage_examples.en: The sailor made a slip knot on the rope to keep the boat tied.

usage_examples.mt: Ir-riħ kien qawwi u l-flokk tal-vapur kien miftuħ għal kollox.
usage_examples.en: The wind was strong and the ship's jib was fully unfurled.

definitions.text_mt: Qlugħ żgħir ieħor imqiegħed quddiem il-flokk ewlieni fuq bastiment

usage_examples.mt: Il-flokk ta' quddiem infetaħ hekk kif bdejna nbaħħru 'l barra mill-bajja.
usage_examples.en: The flying jib was unfurled as we began to sail out of the bay.

definitions.text_en: Floriana (a town and local council of the Port Region, Malta)
definitions.text_mt: Belt u kunsill lokali fir-Reġjun tal-Port ta' Malta, li tinsab bejn il-Belt Valletta u l-belt ta' Ħamrun

usage_examples.mt: Floriana hija belt sabiħa ħdejn il-Belt Valletta b'ħafna parks.
usage_examples.en: Floriana is a beautiful town near Valletta with many parks.

usage_examples.mt: Il-Furjana għandha wkoll it-tim tal-futbol tagħha stess.
usage_examples.en: Floriana also has its own football team.

definitions.text_mt: Muniti jew karti tal-flus użati bħala mezz ta' pagament għal oġġetti u servizzi

usage_examples.mt: M'għandix biżżejjed flus biex nixtri dik il-karozza l-ġdida.
usage_examples.en: I do not have enough money to buy that new car.

usage_examples.mt: Il-flus ma jagħtux l-hena, imma jgħinu biex tgħix aħjar.
usage_examples.en: Money does not bring happiness, but it helps one live better.

usage_examples.mt: Qed inaddaf il-flus għall-vaganzi tas-sajf.
usage_examples.en: I am saving up money for the summer holidays.

definitions.text_en: cash (money in the form of notes/bills and coins)
definitions.text_mt: Flus fi flus kontanti, jiġifieri muniti u karti tal-flus, mhux b'ċekk jew b'karta ta' kreditu

usage_examples.mt: Ħallas bil-flus qabd minflok bil-karta tal-kreditu.
usage_examples.en: He paid with cash instead of with a credit card.

usage_examples.mt: Ma naċċettawx ċekkijiet, biss flus qabd jew b'karta.
usage_examples.en: We do not accept cheques, only cash or card.
